text:
Ana (Sales): FYI incoming POC with FinRegCo. They want all inference traffic and logs to stay in EU for the duration of the eval. Can we confirm boundaries and any extra pricing?
FinRegCo - Alice: Correct — EU-only ingress/egress, BYOK preferred, subprocessors list, and a statement on IP origination for egress. Need this for our security board tomorrow.
Jordan (SE): Quick checklist: region pinning, subprocessor attestation, egress IP ranges, control-plane vs data-plane separation, and BYOK flow. I can validate model availability in eu-west-1.
Maria (Ops): Region pinning (tenant affinity) is doable for a POC — we can reserve a tenant on eu-west-1 for trial. Ops note: this will remove cross-region fallthrough; autoscaling still works within the region.
Li (Legal): For subprocessors we need to provide the current list and note any planned changes. Also confirm that logs/audit retention can be restricted to EU. We'll need a short attestation doc, not the full DPA.
Jordan (SE): Ops, can you confirm egress IPs? Customer wants a short-lived IP set they can whitelist.
Maria (Ops): We publish region egress ranges but not per-tenant static IPs by default. Options:
- Allocate a NAT IP block for the tenant (ops changes + extra cost)
- Advise customer to whitelist Redwood eu egress CIDR.
If customer needs single-IP, we can do a dedicated NAT (estimate + timeline).
Ana (Sales): Pricing impact? Customer expects a number for the POC quote today.
Maria (Ops): Dedicated NAT + tenant pin adds a monthly ops surcharge and 1-2 days lead time. For POC (2 weeks) we can do a temporary NAT allocation — one-time setup fee ~ $500 and hourly rate while allocated. I'll get an exact number.
Jordan (SE): BYOK: FinRegCo wants their keys in Azure Key Vault (or AWS KMS). We support BYOK via external KMS — sequence is: customer grants Redwood access, we store key reference, control plane never sees raw key. Simple sample config: 
```
redwood: {
  region: "eu-west-1",
  tenant_pin: true,
  kms_provider: "azure",
  kms_key_ref: "https://.../keys/finreg-key"
}
```
Maria (Ops): Ops task: open ticket to provision temporary NAT and track cost center.
deploy-bot: Deployment status: eu-west-1 capacity OK, reserved pools available (2 nodes).
Li (Legal): Also FYI — if subprocessors include third-party logging drivers, we need to call that out. Jordan, can you confirm which services touch logs for POC?
Jordan (SE): For the POC (generation + embeddings) logs only touch the control plane audit stream and customer-requested retention store; data-plane artifacts (model KV caches) stay in-region. No external logging providers used unless customer opts in.
FinRegCo - Alice: We need the subprocessors list and the egress IP range before EOD. Also confirm SLA/rollback if we fail residency.
Ana (Sales): I'll consolidate: action items: 1) Maria to confirm exact egress CIDR or NAT quote; 2) Maria to open ops ticket for temp NAT; 3) Jordan to provide short technical note on BYOK and which services touch logs; 4) Li to draft attestation for subprocessors + EU log retention; 5) Sales to produce POC quote by EOD.
Maria (Ops): On it — filing ticket now, will post ticket link when created.
Jordan (SE): Drafting the BYOK + logs note, will post snippet here in 30m.
Li (Legal): Drafting attestation, will need final subprocessors list from infra team (should be the standard list for eu-west).
FinRegCo - Alice: Thanks — if you can supply the CIDR and attestation we can onboard the security board. :pray:
Ana (Sales): Quick test customers can run to verify endpoint routing: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <trial-key>" --resolve "api.redwood.ai:443:52.19.23.11"
```
Note: replace IP with provided egress IP; this helps them validate firewall rules.
Maria (Ops): Ticket created: OPS-7892 — temp NAT allocation for FinRegCo POC. ETA for IP list 4h.
Jordan (SE): BYOK snippet posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/byok-eu-poc (internal link).
Ana (Sales): Great. I'll push quote with two options: (A) standard POC (whitelist CIDR) — no setup fee, (B) POC + dedicated NAT (single-IP) — setup fee + hourly.
FinRegCo - Alice: Please include estimated time to revoke the NAT and rotate keys after the POC.
Maria (Ops): Revoke ~30m ops work, key rotation depends on provider but we can script rotation within the POC window.
Li (Legal): I'll attach the attestation once subprocessors confirmed.
Ana (Sales): I'll send the two-option quote + timeline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
